item.title: First time SCP-Writer
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch:
My SCP is a rabbit that occasionally creates small balls of fur that are hostile towards humans or other animals when they feel threatened
They attack through means of forcing people to cuddle with them followed by hypnotizing them, causing them to seize all other activities.

Central Narrative:
The SCP is a white rabbit that was discovered in a park surrounded by a bunch of its created fur balls instances that were causing people to fall into hypnosis.
The foundation got notified about the event and came in to capture the SCP and terminate it furball instances. It is later revealed during research that the SCP has multiple anomalous effects and how to counter them.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
This idea is something I haven’t read before on the wiki, and I think the idea tells a very interesting concept, seeing as its story fits with foundation lore.

Additional Notes:
I'm a first-time writer and I don't really if this idea is strong enough for the site, so any help/ critique is welcome.
